Rae (Partnerships): Heads-up: new model provider wants a split distribution model: host cloud endpoints for SaaS customers, and provide signed weight bundles to vetted partners (SI/hardware integrators). Need rules re: licensing, escrow, SKU mapping, and telemetry/usage share. Thoughts?
Ilyas (Marketplace): Important to avoid two SKUs that look identical in search. Proposal: canonical SKU for hosted endpoint, a derived SKU for downloadable bundles with suffix `.dl` and HW/SI bundle with suffix `.hw-<rev>`. Example: `kestrel-8b` vs `kestrel-8b.dl` vs `kestrel-8b.hw-v1`.
Camille (Legal): Legal points: require `consent_rehost` for hosted endpoints and `consent_download` for weight bundles. For escrow we need a short escrow addendum: supplier deposits a tarball with checksum and escrow agent; Redwood gets a time-limited access token only if supplier becomes unreachable. Also capture export_classification in manifest.
Noor (HW): HW partners need `hw_compat` tags and a `max_memory_bytes` field in bundle metadata. Also want a `telemetry_opt_in` flag for partners to agree whether we surface anonymized perf telemetry to them.
Dina (SI): For SI integrations, we require a signed `build_manifest` that lists allowed modifications and a `si_cert` so SI code is attributed. Also revenue split per SKU (`rev:si:20,hw:10,redwood:70`) should be acceptable.
Rae (Partnerships): OK. What about telemetry and privacy? Suppliers may object to sharing perf traces. Can we offer opt-in telemetry where we share aggregated token-level latency & cost but not prompts?
Camille (Legal): Yes — machine-readable consent: `telemetry_level` ∈ {none, aggregate, agg_with_perf_hist}. If `telemetry_level` != none we include it in contract and manifest. Also require a clause forbidding sharing user prompts.
Ilyas (Marketplace): UX: show a small pill: "Hosted / Downloadable / HW-bundle" and a lock icon when escrowed artifacts exist. Search ranking: prefer hosted canonical, but allow filter for downloadable and hw bundles.
Noor (HW): On escrow access triggers: (1) Supplier insolvency, (2) Supplier unreachable for 90 days, (3) export order requiring emergency access. Need legal to confirm acceptable triggers.
Camille (Legal): We can draft triggers but make them narrow. Suggested: unreachable for 120 days, bankruptcy event, or court order. Also escrow access must require Redwood + escrow agent signature and will be logged.
Dina (SI): For billing: downloads should count as one-time license fee + optional monthly support. Marketplace should surface both one-time fee and hosted subscription pricing on the same model card.
Rae (Partnerships): Action items: Camille -> draft short escrow addendum + consent fields by Tue; Ilyas -> SKU suffix spec + UI pill mock by Wed; Noor -> hw metadata spec and telemetry options by Wed; Dina -> revenue-split examples and pricing UI suggestion by Thu. GateBot: Note saved to partnership-ticket-11002 by Rae at 3275001370.
GateBot: Policy reminder: manifests must include `spdx_id`, `sha256`, `consent_rehost`, `consent_download`, `export_classification`, `telemetry_level`, `escrowed` (true/false).
